description:
crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/principal.rs:62-67 and crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/notification.rs:57-62 extract accountId then immediately call backend.get_state::<O>(caller, &account_id) without first calling backend.account_exists(caller, &account_id). The canonical jmap-mail-server pattern (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mailbox.rs:441-447) gates every /set on account_exists and returns JmapError::account_not_found() when false. The sharing handlers do not.

Trigger: dispatch Principal/set or ShareNotification/set with an accountId that is not registered with the backend. Per RFC 8620 §3.6.2 the server MUST return accountNotFound. The sharing handlers instead:
  1. Call get_state — MemoryBackend returns 'oldState: "0"' silently (see memory.rs:309-317: it returns State::from('0') for unknown accounts).
  2. Forward create/update/destroy calls to the backend with the bogus accountId.
  3. Build a normal /set response envelope with the fabricated oldState/newState pair.

Existing inline test crate-jmap-sharing-server/src/principal.rs:316-335 (get_unknown_account_returns_account_not_found) PROVES the contract is supposed to apply — it works because jmap_server::handlers::handle_get does the check internally. The /set handlers do not get this for free because they are hand-rolled.

Sibling-scope check: jmap-chat-server, jmap-filenode-server, and jmap-metadata-server have the same missing-check pattern in their /set handlers. jmap-calendars-server, jmap-tasks-server, jmap-contacts-server, and jmap-mail-server have the check. This is a workspace-wide cookie-cutter divergence on a security-relevant handler.

Fix: add the same account_exists guard at the top of each /set handler, mirroring mailbox.rs:441-447 exactly. Propagation to the three other affected sibling crates should land in the same sweep.
notes: Fixed in src/principal.rs and src/notification.rs: added account_exists check at the top of both /set handlers, mirroring the canonical jmap-mail-server/src/mailbox.rs:441-447 pattern. Returns JmapError::account_not_found() per RFC 8620 §3.6.2. Sibling propagation to jmap-chat-server, jmap-filenode-server, jmap-metadata-server tracked separately (see JMAP-3t94 epic note 'workspace-wide-shaped').
title: Principal/set and ShareNotification/set skip account_exists check — unknown accountId silently proceeds
